summary: Centralized TLS rsyslog logging is configured and verified across node1-node4.
actions_performed: Installed matching rsyslog TLS modules and dependencies.
Generated private CA and node certificates with protected key files.
Configured local0-only durable TLS forwarding from node1-node3 to node4.
Configured node4 mutual-TLS listener on 6514/TCP with source-specific logs.
Configured daily compressed rotation, 14 rotations, and 14-day retention.
Verified services, TLS sessions, filtering, compressed rotation, and no cleartext listener.
